verdict.rationale: Twenty's own docs state that workflows can be triggered on schedules, alongside record changes, manual actions and webhooks. Those scheduled workflows can chain record operations, HTTP requests, code, AI agents, delays and more, so recurring automated jobs are a first-party capability. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of schedule configuration (cron expressions, intervals, time zones), any limits or reliability guarantees for scheduled runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
